description: Render the canvas (or given ids) as PNG and send it to a destination from snipaya_list_destinations. Uploads to network destinations always ask the user to confirm first. Returns the link or file path.

beautify.description: Frame the image on a background. true uses the user’s beautify settings, an object overrides some of them, false turns it off. Omit to follow the user’s setting.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_export_to
title: Export to destination
